newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown/dollar at 26.246 (26.408).
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown/dollar at 26.246 (26.408).

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.246 to the dollar after Friday's fixing at 26.408 and at 17.761 to the mark from 17.720.
The CNB said the bid/ask quote, which applies only to traders dealing with the central bank, was 26.180/312 to the dollar, and 17.717/805 for the mark.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of +3.55 percent, after a deviation of +3.50 percent on Friday.
